blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Last-Mile & Urban Logistics. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Last mile is the costliest mile: route density, delivery promise, failed-delivery economics and urban access rules. Dynamic routing, fleet telemetry and micro-hub orchestration decide whether the final mile makes money.

items: Address issues and redeliveries by call center.
Dynamic multi-stop routing exceeds solver time budgets.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decision Intelligence Systems, Process & Task Mining, Agentic Process Automation from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Dynamic routing, Delivery promise management, Failed-delivery recovery) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Urban access/LEZ rules among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.
Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Logistics & Supply Chain level this capability reads as: dynamic route/load re-planning within policy when events hit (re-plan in minutes at network scale). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
